subject.title: Slack Socket Mode events not reaching Gateway despite full config per documentation

question: Should maintainers keep this broad Slack Socket Mode report open pending the missing redacted diagnostics, or route it now to a specific existing Slack Socket Mode issue?
rationale: The public issue does not include the attached report, and the same title-level symptom can map to reaction delivery, zombie liveness, account filtering, or a different Slack ingress failure.

options.title: Keep Pending Diagnostics
options.body: Keep this open and ask for the redacted local report or equivalent current-main status, trace logs, and raw event envelope before routing or fixing.

options.title: Route To Reaction Delivery
options.body: If the missing report is reaction-only, close or link this to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56653 as the canonical reaction Socket Mode issue.

options.title: Route To Liveness
options.body: If the report shows healthy Socket Mode with no later events or stale status, route it to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 as the canonical liveness issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Pending Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep this open and ask for the redacted local report or equivalent current-main status, trace logs, and raw event envelope before routing or fixing.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision is about broad Slack monitor triage and the Socket Mode filtering/liveness boundary where this history points.
